note: doc/phase3_5_tasks_and_acceptance.md section 4.2. The upstream components this stage reuses, pinned. R35-UP-01 requires the real upstream symbols to run, not a reimplementation wearing their name; R35-UP-02 requires a version mismatch to be a stable error rather than a silent fall back to no-LL.

triton.role: LinearLayout, AxisInfo, and the TTIR the frontend already reads
triton.boundary: The R1 acceptance pins a Triton WHEEL; the C++ LinearLayout lives in a source tree with its own LLVM. Section 4.2 forbids linking distribution MLIR 20 and a separately pinned LLVM into one process, so the two do not meet inside a process.
triton.resolution: an isolated helper that owns one matched Triton/LLVM, spoken to over versioned text or a versioned data protocol -- no MLIR object crosses an ABI

mlir.role: canonicalisation, CSE, the pass manager, the verifier and diagnostics
mlir.runs_on: pure-value regions with an explicit effect boundary only

runtime_rule.why: Section 4.2: loading an artifact must not import Triton, LLVM or LinearLayout, and must not need them installed. R35-PKG-02 checks a runtime-only install.

helper.name: tnca-layout-opt
helper.kind: a separate compile-time tool, or an equally isolated adapter
helper.protocol: versioned text or a versioned data protocol
forbidden: passing MLIR objects across an ABI boundary
linking two LLVM versions into one process
importing a private, unexported Python symbol from the Triton wheel
upgrading the R1 or R2 toolchain to make this build

status: PLANNED -- no adapter has been built yet. R35-UP-01 is NOT VERIFIED and this file records the boundary it has to respect, not a boundary it already respects.
